Environment.CreatedExactlyWhenVersioned.source:
(s) =>
			[
				[s.status === "", s.version === 0, s.name === ""].every((ok) => ok),
				[s.status !== "", s.version >= 1, s.name !== ""].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Environment.ArchivedNeverReactivates.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.status !== "archived",
				[
					after.status === "archived",
					after.version === before.version,
					after.name === before.name,
				].every((ok) => ok),
				[
					after.status === "deleted",
					after.version === before.version,
					after.name === before.name,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Environment.DeletedStaysDeleted.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.status !== "deleted",
				[
					after.status === "deleted",
					after.version === before.version,
					after.name === before.name,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Environment.VersionGrowsByOneOrNotAtAll.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				[
					before.status === "",
					[
						[after.status === "", after.version === 0].every((ok) => ok),
						[after.status === "active", after.version === 1].every((ok) => ok),
					].some((ok) => ok),
				].every((ok) => ok),
				[
					before.status !== "",
					after.status !== "",
					[
						[after.version === before.version, after.name === before.name].every((ok) => ok),
						[
							before.status === "active",
							after.status === "active",
							after.version === before.version + 1,
						].every((ok) => ok),
					].some((ok) => ok),
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Environment.ConfiguredExactlyWhenCreated.source:
(s) =>
			[
				[s.status === "", s.description === null, s.config === null].every((ok) => ok),
				[s.status !== "", s.config !== null].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Environment.UpdateKeepsWhatItDoesNotName.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			command._tag !== "UpdateEnvironment" ||
			[
				after.name === (command.changes.name === undefined ? before.name : command.changes.name),
				after.description ===
					(command.changes.description === undefined
						? before.description
						: command.changes.description),
				after.config !== null &&
					before.config !== null &&
					sameNetworkingFlags(
						after.config.networking,
						command.changes.config === undefined
							? before.config.networking
							: command.changes.config.networking,
					),
			].every((ok) => ok)
